pipeline.license_origin: In-licensed from University of Virginia Patent Foundation

indications.indication: Alcohol Use Disorder (AUD) in patients with selected serotonin transporter/receptor polymorphisms
indications.trial_name: ONWARD (completed); next adaptive Phase 3 in planning per July 29, 2025 FDA Type C meeting
indications.trial_design: Prior ONWARD: randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, 6-month, in genotype-positive heavy-drinking AUD patients. Planned next study: adaptive Phase 3 design discussed with FDA.

FDA Type C meeting minutes received July 2025 confirming adaptive Phase 3 path
European commercialization partnership framework announced (estimated >$60M deal value)
